groups.saying_opens: أتاه رجلان في فتنة ابن الزبير
أن رجلا، أتى ابن عمر فقال

notes: «وزاد عثمان بن صالح» adds a second saying (the Hajj and jihad exchange) with its own transmitters, so it is stored as a second group.
«فلان» is the text's placeholder for an unnamed transmitter and is kept unnamed.
Ibn Umar is the one asked and answering in the second saying, so he is its last link (rule 6).
